596: fn insert_url_params<B>(req: &mut Request<B>, params: Vec<(String, String)>) {
597:     let params = params
598:         .into_iter()
599:         .map(|(k, v)| {
600:             if let Some(decoded) = PercentDecodedByteStr::new(v) {
601:                 Ok((ByteStr::new(k), decoded))
602:             } else {
603:                 Err(InvalidUtf8InPathParam {
604:                     key: ByteStr::new(k),

606:             }
607:         })
608:         .collect::<Result<Vec<_>, _>>();
609: 
610:     if let Some(current) = req.extensions_mut().get_mut::<Option<UrlParams>>() {
611:         match params {
612:             Ok(params) => {
613:                 let mut current = current.take().unwrap();
614:                 if let Ok(current) = &mut current.0 {
615:                     current.extend(params);
616:                 }
617:                 req.extensions_mut().insert(Some(current));
618:             }
619:             Err(err) => {
620:                 req.extensions_mut().insert(Some(UrlParams(Err(err))));
621:             }
622:         }
623:     } else {
624:         req.extensions_mut().insert(Some(UrlParams(params)));
625:     }
